answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. The quartz holds work receipts rather than names, so the horizon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the dune of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
